pr_title: Keep the symbolic link after editing credentials.yml.enc
pr_body:
### Summary

If you edit credentials.yml.enc after creating a symbolic link,
the symbolic link is removed and overwritten with a normal file.
This commit changes the behavior to keep the symbolic link.

Fixes #36411
pr_comments:

issue_context.title: Edit credentials.yml.enc will remove the Symbolic Link
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce
<!-- (Guidelines for creating a bug report are [available
here](https://edgeguides.rubyonrails.org/contributing_to_ruby_on_rails.html#creating-a-bug-report)) -->
create a Symbolic Link for credentials.yml.enc
ln -s /shared/config/credentials.yml.enc  /current/config/credentials.yml.enc
The eidt the current/config/credetnials.yml.enc and save
### Expected behavior
<!-- Tell us what should happen -->
credentials.yml.enc -> /shared/config/credentials.yml.enc
### Actual behavior
<!-- Tell us what happens instead -->
credentials.yml.enc
The symbolic link has been removed
### System configuration
**OS version**:
NAME="Amazon Linux AMI"
VERSION="2018.03"
ID="amzn"
ID_LIKE="rhel fedora"
VERSION_ID="2018.03"
PRETTY_NAME="Amazon Linux AMI 2018.03"
ANSI_COLOR="0;33"
CPE_NAME="cpe:/o:amazon:linux:2018.03:ga"
HOME_URL="http://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/"
**Rails version**:
5.2.1
**Ruby version**:
2.4.4
### Releated Code
activesupport/lib/active_support/encrypted_file.rb

def write(contents)
  IO.binwrite "#{content_path}.tmp", encrypt(contents)
  FileUtils.mv "#{content_path}.tmp", content_path
end

That mv make the credentials.yml.enc become a new file, which will remove the symbolic link
comments:

I try both macOS High Sierra and amazon AMI

I have the same issue with Rails `6.0` on the master branch. It is relevant if you use capistrano to deploy your Rails application, you are symlinking the `credentials.yml.enc` and you edit the file using `rails credentials:edit`.

My workaround is to copy the  `current/config/credentials.yml.enc` to `shared/config/credentials.yml.enc` after the changes have been done.
